title: Medical Assistance Case Upkeep: Tier Placement, Daily Rate Letters, Renewals and Closing
content:
**Rule.** The tier of a Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage case follows the allowances on the County Assistance Office notice or worksheet: a community spouse allowance places it in the community spouse tier, a dependent family allowance in the dependent family tier, a VA pension reduced to the protected amount in the VA tier, a home maintenance allowance in the home maintenance tier for no longer than the home maintenance maximum months, a hospice election in the hospice room and board tier, and otherwise the standard tier. The Medicaid daily rate is updated from each new center rate letter. Renewals fall due every renewal interval. An eligible case is closed only when its patient pay balance and pending balance are both zero.

**Tier placement table.**

| On the notice or worksheet | Tier of the case |
|---|---|
| a community spouse allowance | Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Community Spouse Allowance |
| a dependent family allowance | Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Dependent Family Allowance |
| a VA pension reduced to the protected amount | Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, VA Reduced Pension |
| a home maintenance allowance | Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Home Maintenance Allowance, for no longer than 6 months |
| a hospice election | Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board |
| none of these | Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Standard Patient Pay |

**Other upkeep.** The Medicaid daily rate on the case is updated from each new center rate letter. Renewals fall due every 12 months. Spousal resources are counted as of the start of the first continuous period of institutionalization.

**Closing an eligible case.** The case record must show both balances at zero:

| Patient pay balance | Pending balance | Eligible case may be closed |
|---|---|---|
| zero | zero | yes |
| not zero | zero | no |
| zero | not zero | no |
| not zero | not zero | no |
